Taylor: Quick sync 1: need a tiny canonical page for function/tool calling + a migration blurb for v1->v2. Keep examples minimal and language diverse (py/ts/go).
Rina: I'll draft the migration blurb: 3 steps — validate against schema, use compat shim if needed, fallback heuristic. Short and copyable.
Omar: I'll produce snippets. Plan: Python (rwd.chat.call_tool), TS (fetch + ajv), Go micro-example. Also add one compact JSON schema demonstrating nullable arrays.
devex-bot: Reminder: tag `devex` for SDK snippet review and run link-checker after redirects.
Taylor: Guardrails: include tests for missing required key, extra unknown keys, and items=null. Keep each test tiny.
Rina: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 (migration + snippets outline).
Omar: Snippet PR coming in an hour. I'll add small parse-fallback examples and a note about trimming trailing commas.
Taylor: Timeline: PRs by EOD, review early next week. Post commit links here so we have a single audit trail.
